  InternalS3BucketName:
    Description: Name of the internal S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref InternalS3BucketName
  InternalS3BucketUser:
    Description: IAM user with s3:* on the internal bucket only
    Value: !Ref InternalS3BucketUser
  S3StratioAppsSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the secret storing access key for the internal S3 bucket (read by s3-requisites.sh env)
    Value: !Ref S3StratioAppsSecret
